_comment: The ONE registry of the approver package identity (issue #101). Read by scripts/approver-msix.mjs (manifest, package family name) and scripts/approver-msix-install.ps1 (certificate subject, package name). The C# mirror is src/runtime/windows-approver/PackageIdentity.cs (ApproverIdentity); test/approver-msix.test.mjs fails if they differ. Changing publisher or packageName changes the package family name, which orphans the enrolled Hello key: re-enrol and update the Authority config.
description: The human console of the ALBERA Approval Authority. Its Windows Hello key belongs to this package.
